lede: Next week, Mon Nov 23 to Sun Nov 29 (Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26, Black Friday Fri Nov 27): 7 evening videos (Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels and Pinterest video pins), 13 image pins and 2 carousels (Instagram and Facebook). New this week: named Instagram series with a follow line and a tomorrow teaser on every Reel (to grow followers), 3 maze Reels, and 8 posts labeled as experiments. Tap a thumbnail to open the full media.

insights.data_note: Pulled from Buffer on Sat Nov 21 (about 2:40 AM ET): posts sent Nov 7 to Nov 21, plus aggregates for Nov 14-20 vs Nov 7-13. Posts under 24 h old (the Fri Nov 20 evening Reels, the Fri Nov 20 evening Couples carousel and the Fri 9 PM video pin) were ignored. Pinterest and Facebook metrics lag and are very small. Sample sizes are tiny, so these are hints, not trends. No Amazon Attribution sales data was available to this run.
adjustments: DO MORE: mazes. The 4 maze Reels (Nov 10, 14, 17, 20) got 3,790 views and a steady 8.2 s average watch; the other 7 Reels since Nov 10 averaged 86 views and 3.9 s. Three maze Reels again (Tue, Thu, Sun, shapes hexagon, circle, square), plus a rectangle maze pin and a maze gift pin. Mazes were also the best Facebook Reel (540 impressions, the only 2 clicks) and the only pins with a reaction.

START: Instagram series on every Reel (tag in the first frame, plain follow line and a tomorrow teaser on the end card and in the caption): Mon and Sat Memory Lane Quiz, Tue/Thu/Sun Maze of the Day, Wed Ask Your Parents, Fri Quick Trivia. Mon and Tue are swapped versus the growth plan because Sunday Nov 22 is a maze and no template runs two days in a row.

TEST (retention, labeled): Mon 1-question Memory quiz (about 10 s) and Thu 5-second maze (about 11 s). Goal: beat 8 s average watch on a shorter video. Also a Wed Parents timer (the weakest Reel format, 8 and 139 views) with a Thanksgiving-eve hook, unlabeled so we see whether the hook fixes it.
TEST (labeled): the IG 'save and follow' carousel (Wed, Parents, last slide is a follow card; the Facebook copy keeps the book card), and a Random trivia pin with the answer revealed on the image.
DO LESS: no Couples or About Me video this week (their timer videos got 62-137 views and 2.4-5.0 s on Instagram); they stay on pins and one Couples carousel on Sat.

NO CHANGE for Pinterest volume (20 pins): impressions are 0-8 per pin, too small to steer by. Keep the seasonal mix: Thanksgiving, Black Friday and Christmas gift pins (Parents, Memory Lane, Mazes, Couples), 5 trivia pins. No posting-slot test this week because there is no signal to compare.
If Buffer still shows 0 follows after week 50, the plan is to stop spending effort on Instagram growth and focus on Pinterest and Facebook.

instagram.summary: Nov 14-20 (7 days): 9 posts, 2,822 views, reach 2,340, avg watch 5.8 s, 30 reactions, 0 comments, 1 save, 1 share, 0 FOLLOWS (prior 7 days: 8 posts, 1,788 views, 3.8 s, 0 follows). The 4 maze Reels held about 8.2 s each (51% of 16 s); the other 7 Reels held 2.6-5.5 s. Follows per post and per series: 0 everywhere (the series tags only start this week, so there is no per-series data yet). Carousels: Buffer returns 0 views for IG carousels, so no usable carousel data. Total views since Nov 7 are well above week one, but almost all come from mazes.
best: Fri Nov 13 maze (circle): 1,497 views, 8.2 s watch, 20 reactions, 1 save, 1 share. A visual task with a clock from frame 1.
Mon Nov 9 maze (rectangle): 1,246 views, 8.3 s watch, 13 reactions. Same format.
Thu Nov 19 maze (square): 625 views, 8.2 s watch (Mon Nov 16 maze: 422). Same format, lower reach than the first two.
worst: Wed Nov 18 Parents timer: 8 views, 2.7 s watch. Text-only question card, low reach.
Tue Nov 17 Memory quiz: 23 views, 4.2 s. Low reach even though watch time was average.
Sat Nov 7 Memory quiz (old 28 s format): 64 views, 1.8 s (Wed Nov 11 Parents timer: 139 views but 2.6 s).

facebook.summary: Nov 14-20: 10 posts, 1,720 impressions, reach 1,600, 0 reactions, 4 comments (probably our own first-comment links), 0 shares, 2 clicks (prior 7 days: 8 posts, 887 impressions, 1 comment, 0 clicks). Per Reel about 200-280 impressions, whatever the book; the maze Reel stood out. The two multi-photo posts got 0 impressions and only the first comment.
best: Thu Nov 19 maze (square): 540 impressions, 2 clicks (the only clicks). Mazes again, older audience.
worst: Memory carousel (Nov 19 6 PM ET): 0 impressions, 1 comment (our own link).
Mon Nov 9 to Fri Nov 13 Reels (maze, Random, Parents, maze): 1-2 impressions each, an unexplained dip on older posts that never recovered.
Multi-photo posts in general: 0-2 impressions. If this stays flat after week 50, drop the Facebook carousels.

pinterest.summary: Nov 14-20: 18 pins, 10 impressions, 0 saves, 0 clicks (prior 7 days: 18 pins, 80 impressions, 0 clicks, 3 video views). Pinterest metrics lag by days and each pin shows 0-8 impressions, so no slice (format, book, slot, board) can be compared. The only 2 engagements in 2 weeks were one reaction each on a Wed maze pin and a Sun maze pin.
best: Tue Nov 10 Couples 5-question list pin: 8 impressions (4:00 PM ET slot).
Tue Nov 10 Memory 'October man' hook pin: 7 impressions.
Wed Nov 11 maze pin (square) and Sun Nov 15 maze pin (hexagon): 6 and 1 impressions, 1 reaction each (the only reactions).
worst: All pins since Mon Nov 16: 0 impressions, probably metric lag (not a slice finding).
Video pins: 0-6 impressions and 0-2 views each.
pinterest.errors: Errors: 3 pins failed in the window. Trivia video pins with 'this site doesn't allow pins to be saved': Memory Sat Nov 7 (w45) and Random Tue Nov 10 (w46). One Random image pin (Mon Nov 16, octopus) failed with 'unknown error, please retry'. Every other Random and Memory video and image pin sent fine, including the Random video pin on Sun Nov 15 and the Memory video pin on Tue Nov 17. So the 'site doesn't allow pins' error is intermittent and has not recurred since Nov 10.

insights.caveats: Instagram carousels return no metrics, Facebook looks throttled or lagged on older posts, Pinterest is too small to compare, and follows are 0 across the board. All differences above are hints on 20-40 posts, not proof.
